name: Dan Farrington

bio.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Farrington lists his occupation as retired, with a background as business development manager at Barrett Business Services Inc. and owner of Sunrise Medical Consultants.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book7)

bio.statement: His statement lists a B.A. in Education from Oregon State University.

positions.statement: Farrington says he will cut taxes and regulations and restore free-market principles so families keep more of what they earn.
